items.title: Richard McLean Interview, 1959-05-27
items.q: That was some of the band. I'm telling you now, Cindy Correll, White, Lee Collins, and Freddie Babu.

ctx.x: He had heard me playing several times on the guitar and he'd come along and he asked me what I play with. I told him, yeah, I said, well, I reached for the guitar, it'd come to my house. He said, no, bring the banjo. I said, well, I can't play the banjo. I said, I'm learning how to play, but I can't play. He said, well, I'll tell you what to do. He said, you know how you tune the first four strings on your guitar? I said, yeah. He said, you tune your banjo just like that. Yeah. He said, the only thing you don't…
